verdict.rationale: AutoGen's docs advertise a 'Memory' component ('Add memory capabilities to your agents') as part of AgentChat, indicating some support for giving agents memory, but the evidence pack gives no detail on how this memory persists across sessions/threads (e.g., storage backend, serialization, retrieval across conversations). missing for 10: explicit documentation of session/thread-persistent memory implementation, examples of memory surviving across separate runs, independent/hands-on confirmation.
